name: ramp-while-playing
about: Re-check: step locks set while the replica plays land on their steps.

steps.say: make a 4 bar chord loop on track 7 and play it
while it plays, make the filter open a bit more each bar

name: fill-in-bar-2
about: Re-check: one bar merged, the rest of that bar kept.

steps.say: make a 2 bar beat
add a snare fill only at the end of bar 2, keep everything else in that bar

name: lab-merge-takes
about: Re-check: lab takes written with merge, read back.

steps.say: make a house beat
try two different kick patterns for me to compare, keep the rest

name: swell-3-seconds
about: Re-check: an envelope stage set by its time.

steps.say: make the pad on track 8 swell in over 3 seconds, and put a chord on it

name: thirds-above
about: Re-check: a harmony by scale steps.

steps.say: write a 2 bar melody on track 5 in A minor
add a harmony a third above on track 6

name: gb-major
about: Re-check: a flat key's own letters (Cb).

steps.say: write a melody in Gb major on track 5 and name its notes

name: lofi-swung-hats
about: Re-check: the groove note by sound.

steps.say: make a lofi beat where the hats really swing

name: synth-on-channel-2
about: Re-check: the midi engine and the unit's own browser.

steps.say: use track 6 to play my synth on midi channel 2

name: groove-amount-walk
about: Re-check: a walkthrough to the groove amount.

steps.say: light the keys so I can set the groove to 40 myself
did I do it right?

name: beat-lesson
about: A lesson followed by hand over several steps.

steps.say: teach me to put a kick on every beat on track 1, light the keys
what next?
make a beat
copy it to pattern 2 and make pattern 2 busier, then play pattern 1 then 2
make a beat with a bass
the bass is too loud compared to the drums

name: crash-every-4
about: A song-level accent: a crash every four bars.

steps.say: make a song with a verse and a chorus, 4 bars each
put a crash on the first beat of every 4 bars

name: breakdown-song
about: A structure asked for at once.

steps.say: set up a song: 4 bars of just drums, then 8 bars with everything, then a 4 bar breakdown with only the chords

name: what-bpm
about: A question about the state after building.

steps.say: make a drum and bass beat
what bpm is this at, and how long is one loop?
make something in the spirit of Daft Punk, a filtered disco loop, without copying a song

name: funk-carioca
about: A request in Portuguese, a genre not tried yet.

steps.say: faça uma batida de funk carioca com um baixo
make a beat at 140
stop it and put the tempo back to the default
